question: Which cost centers came in worst against budget in Q3, and what does the driver look like?
answer:
[PARTIAL - Q3 2024: 147 ledger row(s) worth 1,231,309.12 EUR have no rate on file and are excluded from every figure below, so each total is a floor and not a total.]

In Q3 2024 (USD) the worst variances are concentrated in MI‑US / OPS‑AMER: by value the top overruns are account 6620 (actual 450,780.34 vs budgets 135,679.68 / 155,614.69), 6110 (actual 579,167.72 vs budgets 285,017.33 / 321,130.19) and 6610 (actual 323,606.45 vs budgets 101,768.61 / 120,226.73); by percent the top are 6620, 6610 and 6630 (6630 actual 46,729.78 vs budgets 14,846.11 / 17,113.61). The primary driver for the largest overrun (6620) is freight-related spend with Kestrel Freight Systems (202,994.59), Ridgeline Carriers (162,974.77) and Nordwind Logistics (84,810.98); note OPS‑AMER has two budget sets, so the deviations are reported as ranges.
